title: Vampire Costume
summary: A themed costume night built around a slow, staged reveal.
details: The theme gives the room a story to follow. Each costume piece is tied to a goal, so viewers feel they are moving the night forward together.
howTo: Put the theme in the room topic and tags before going live.
Open in the full costume, cape on, and set the scene in the first few minutes.
Tie each costume change to a goal. Show progress often so the room believes it can hit it.
Save the best moment for the main goal and hold something back. The room should stay curious.
goalLadder: 25 tk · Fangs on and a hello wave (warm-up)
500 tk · Main goal: full costume reveal
300 tk · Pose chosen by tippers' vote
prompts: + Who's brave enough to wake the vampire? 🦇
+ Halfway to the reveal! Who's helping us get there?
tips: Amounts are examples. Adjust them to the room's traffic and pace.
Easy goals first, then step the amounts down (push and pull).

title: Backless Dress
summary: A low-key, elegant look for quieter rooms, using angles and slow turns.
howTo: Start front-facing and chatty. Build rapport before any turns.
Use slow turns and side angles as goal rewards, not as the opener.
Keep the camera steady and the lighting soft. The look does the work.
If the room is quiet, switch to a filler and come back to the turn goal later.
goalLadder: 20 tk · Twirl to show the dress (warm-up)
300 tk · Main goal: slow turn and pose
100 tk · Tippers pick the next song
prompts: + Should the next pose be over the shoulder or a side profile? Vote with a tip!

title: Belt Bra
summary: A bold outfit night with fast, upbeat goals and music.
howTo: Pick an upbeat playlist and keep the energy high from the start.
Use short, quick goals early to build momentum.
Change the frame between goals so the room never feels static.
